description: Watches the runner's retained job history and learns each job's normal: repeated failures, flakiness, duration drift against its own baseline, and cross-job failure clusters.
name: job_watcher

signals.description: The same job -- same kind and script -- failed at least repeat_failures times inside failure_window_sec; the detail names the dominant exit code and error line.
signals.name: job_failing_repeatedly

signals.description: The job's recent runs alternate between success and failure on the same script, so neither state can be trusted.
signals.name: job_flaky

signals.description: A run took far longer than the job's own rolling baseline (median and MAD over its earlier runs) allows. Never filed for a job with too little history to have a baseline.
signals.name: job_duration_anomaly

signals.description: At least cluster_min_jobs distinct jobs failed inside cluster_window_sec -- the pattern of a sick box, not a sick job.
signals.name: failure_cluster
